full_judgment: 2. Syed Ziaul Karim,  learned Advocate appearing for the defendant-petitioner submits the only point that all the joint property having not been included in the schedule of the partition suit, the  learned Judge of the High Court Division erred in not setting aside the wrong judgment and decree of the courts below. We do not find any substance in his submission in view of the facts that the learned Judge of the High Court Division rightly noticed that all the parties in the partition suit have no common interest in respect of the lands of SA Khatian No. 752, 762 and 764 of the Mouza in question which are alleged to have been left out of the suit. In the facts and circumstances of the case we do not find any illegality in the Impugned judgment.
